proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  change ∀ (a b F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → F ∣ a → F ∣ b → (M5.completeSignature a b N = F ↔ ∀ p : M5.BinaryPolynomial, Irreducible p → p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N / F → ¬ (F * p ∣ a ∧ F * p ∣ b))
  intro a b F N hN hFm hFN hFa hFb
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := hFm.ne_zero
  have hGa : M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ a := by
    unfold M5.completeSignature
    first
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  have hGb : M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ b := by
    unfold M5.completeSignature
    first
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  have hGN : M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N := by
    unfold M5.completeSignature
    first
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _
    | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  constructor
  · intro hEq p hp hpQ hab
    have hpN : F * p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N :=
      (M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient F (M5.cyclicModulus N) p hF0 hFN).mp hpQ
    have hpF : F * p ∣ F := by
      rw [← hEq]
      exact M5.PolynomialExclusion.signature_contains a b (F * p) N hab.1 hab.2 hpN
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hpF
    have hOne : (1 : M5.BinaryPolynomial) = p * q := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hF0
      simpa only [mul_one, mul_assoc] using hq
    exact hp.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_one ⟨q, hOne⟩)
  · intro hExclude
    have hM0 : M5.cyclicModulus N ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hc := congrArg (fun f : M5.BinaryPolynomial => f.coeff 0) hz
      simpa [M5.cyclicModulus, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Nat.ne_of_gt hN, Ne.symm (Nat.ne_of_gt hN)] using hc
    have hG0 : M5.completeSignature a b N ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hM0
      simpa [hz] using hGN
    by_contra hNe
    have hFG : F ∣ M5.completeSignature a b N :=
      M5.PolynomialExclusion.signature_contains a b F N hFa hFb hFN
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpG⟩ :=
      M5.PolynomialExclusion.strict_divisor_extra_factor F (M5.completeSignature a b N) hFm hFG hG0 hNe
    have hpQ : p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N / F :=
      (M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient F (M5.cyclicModulus N) p hF0 hFN).mpr (hpG.trans hGN)
    exact hExclude p hp hpQ ⟨hpG.trans hGa, hpG.trans hGb⟩
